capacity_gross_kwh.notes: Kia US 2026 EV6 page: Light 63.0 kWh. 2027 Light RWD is 63 kWh per Electrek 2027 pricing coverage (search excerpt).

capacity_usable_kwh.notes: EV Database (MY25-27): 60.0 kWh usable of 63.0 nominal.

preconditioning.notes: Estimated: Kia UK page names the EV6: navigation trigger (charger as destination) plus manual start from infotainment/Kia Connect app. UK page, not NA; the 2024 EV6 manual (src-kia-manual-ev6-2024-battery-conditioning) shows the same setting; nothing shows a change at the 2025 refresh. Battery-heater equipment on Light is unconfirmed (Kia US shows no heat pump on Light and the manual says conditioning needs a battery heater), so this may not apply to Light.

dc_max_kw.notes: Estimated: Kia chart relayed by Automoblog is for the 2025 EV6 (Light 180 kW, other 84 kWh trims 240 kW); the 2026/2027 car has the same pack and charger. Automoblog Kia-sourced chart: Light 180 kW max DC input (EVDB EU listing says 195 kW).

ac_max_kw.notes: Estimated: Kia US 2026 EV6 page: 10.9 kW on every trim; the 2027 EV6 keeps the 2026 features.

published_10_80_min.notes: Estimated: from the Kia US 2026 EV6 page; 2027 carries the same hardware. Kia US 2026 EV6: about 20 min 10-80 % at 350 kW (figure from a GT AWD test).
